model.name: Challenger
model.notes: Covers the V6 trims (SXT and GT) for model years 2015-2023. Prices are US MSRP in USD excluding destination unless noted. Each trim and package carries a confidence flag: verified (from an option list or press release), likely (secondary source or carry-over), uncertain (general knowledge, needs checking).

v6-pentastar.name: 3.6L Pentastar V6
v6-pentastar.hint: The 6-cylinder engine in every SXT and GT: about 303-305 hp. Cheaper to run and insure than the V8 R/T, but noticeably slower.

auto-8-speed.name: 8-speed automatic (TorqueFlite)
auto-8-speed.hint: The only transmission offered with the V6. More gears keep the engine in its efficient range, so it is smooth and reasonably economical. No manual was offered on V6 cars.

awd.name: All-wheel drive
awd.hint: Sends power to the front wheels too when the rear ones slip. Big help in rain and snow. The Challenger's system drives the rear wheels normally and disconnects the front axle to save fuel until it is needed.

backup-camera.name: Rear backup camera (ParkView)
backup-camera.hint: Shows what is behind the car on the screen when you shift into reverse, with guide lines.

parksense-rear.name: Rear park assist (ParkSense)
parksense-rear.hint: Sensors in the rear bumper beep faster as you get close to an object while reversing. Different from the camera: it warns you by sound even if you are not looking at the screen.

blind-spot.name: Blind-spot monitoring
blind-spot.hint: A light in the side mirror turns on when a car is in the spot you cannot see over your shoulder. Very useful on a Challenger because rear visibility is poor.

rear-cross-path.name: Rear cross-path detection
rear-cross-path.hint: Warns you when backing out of a parking space if a car is coming from the side, which you often cannot see past neighbouring cars.

forward-collision-warning.name: Forward collision warning
forward-collision-warning.hint: Beeps and flashes if you are closing in on the car ahead too fast. On the Challenger it is a warning only: it does not brake the car for you (no automatic emergency braking).

adaptive-cruise.name: Adaptive cruise control
adaptive-cruise.hint: Cruise control that keeps a set distance from the car ahead, slowing down and speeding up with traffic. Great on highways.

auto-high-beams.name: Automatic high beams
auto-high-beams.hint: Turns the high beams on in the dark and dips them automatically when a car is coming the other way.

rain-sensing-wipers.name: Rain-sensing wipers
rain-sensing-wipers.hint: The wipers switch on and adjust their speed by themselves when it rains.

hid-headlamps.name: HID (xenon) headlamps
hid-headlamps.hint: Brighter, whiter headlights than the standard halogen bulbs. Noticeably better at night.

fog-lamps.name: Front fog lamps
fog-lamps.hint: Low lights in the front bumper that light the road close to the car in fog or heavy rain.

remote-start.name: Remote start
remote-start.hint: Start the engine from the key fob so the cabin is warm or cool before you get in.

keyless-go.name: Keyless entry and push-button start (Keyless Enter 'n Go)
keyless-go.hint: Keep the key in your pocket: touch the door handle to unlock and press a button to start.

power-folding-mirrors.name: Power folding side mirrors
power-folding-mirrors.hint: The side mirrors fold in at the press of a button, handy in tight garages or parking spots.

garage-door-opener.name: Universal garage door opener
garage-door-opener.hint: Buttons in the car you program to open your garage door or gate, so you do not need a separate remote.

dual-zone-climate.name: Dual-zone automatic climate control
dual-zone-climate.hint: Driver and passenger set their own temperatures, and the system holds them automatically.

heated-seats.name: Heated front seats
heated-seats.hint: Warms the seat cushion and back in cold weather.

ventilated-seats.name: Ventilated front seats
ventilated-seats.hint: Fans blow air through small holes in the seats to keep you cool in hot weather. Usually only with leather seats.

heated-steering-wheel.name: Heated steering wheel
heated-steering-wheel.hint: Warms the steering wheel rim so you can drive without gloves in winter.

power-tilt-telescope.name: Power tilt and telescoping steering column
power-tilt-telescope.hint: Moves the steering wheel up, down, in and out with a switch to fit your driving position.

seat-memory.name: Driver seat memory
seat-memory.hint: Saves the driver seat (and often mirror) position so two drivers can switch with one button.

houndstooth-cloth.name: Houndstooth cloth seats
houndstooth-cloth.hint: Durable cloth seats with a retro checked pattern. Standard on the base cars.

nappa-leather.name: Nappa leather seats
nappa-leather.hint: Soft, high-grade leather upholstery. Feels premium and is easier to clean than cloth.

nappa-alcantara.name: Nappa leather and Alcantara performance seats
nappa-alcantara.hint: Sportier seats with bigger side bolsters that hold you in corners, trimmed in leather plus Alcantara (a grippy suede-like fabric).

uconnect-7.name: Uconnect 7-inch touchscreen
uconnect-7.hint: The standard infotainment screen for radio, phone and apps.

uconnect-84.name: Uconnect 8.4-inch touchscreen
uconnect-84.hint: The bigger, faster infotainment screen. Easier to read and unlocks extras like Dodge Performance Pages.

navigation.name: Built-in navigation
navigation.hint: Maps stored in the car. Works without phone signal, but most people now use Apple CarPlay or Android Auto instead.

carplay-android.name: Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
carplay-android.hint: Shows your phone's apps (maps, music, messages) on the car screen. Standard from 2017 with Uconnect 4.

siriusxm.name: SiriusXM satellite radio
siriusxm.hint: Subscription radio with hundreds of channels that works nationwide. Usually comes with a free trial.

wifi-hotspot.name: 4G LTE Wi-Fi hotspot
wifi-hotspot.hint: The car has its own mobile data connection and can share Wi-Fi with passengers (needs a data plan).

performance-pages.name: Dodge Performance Pages
performance-pages.hint: Screens on the touchscreen showing g-forces, lap and 0-60 timers, gauges, plus settings for launch control and drive modes.

launch-control.name: Launch control
launch-control.hint: Holds engine revs and manages wheelspin so you get the quickest possible start from a standstill.

super-track-pak.name: Super Track Pak
super-track-pak.hint: Dodge's name for a sport mode setup: firmer steering and suspension feel, Performance Pages and a sport/track button. Standard on GT, optional on early SXTs.

tft-cluster-7.name: 7-inch digital driver display
tft-cluster-7.hint: A screen between the gauges that shows trip info, tire pressure, navigation prompts and more.

alpine-6.name: Alpine premium audio (6 speakers, 276 W)
alpine-6.hint: Upgraded speakers and amplifier. Clearer and louder than the base stereo.

alpine-9-sub.name: Alpine audio with subwoofer (9 speakers, 506 W)
alpine-9-sub.hint: Adds more speakers and a subwoofer for deep bass and surround sound.

harman-kardon.name: Harman Kardon audio (18 speakers, 900 W)
harman-kardon.hint: The top sound system: 18 speakers and a trunk subwoofer. Concert-like sound.

sunroof.name: Power sunroof
sunroof.hint: A glass panel in the roof that tilts and slides open.

wheels-18.name: 18-inch alloy wheels
wheels-18.hint: Standard size. Taller tire sidewalls give a softer ride and cheaper tires.

wheels-19.name: 19-inch alloy wheels
wheels-19.hint: Bigger wheels than the base car: sharper look and a bit more grip, slightly firmer ride.

wheels-20.name: 20-inch alloy wheels
wheels-20.hint: Large wheels with low-profile tires: aggressive look and better handling, but a firmer ride and pricier tires.

black-exterior.name: Black exterior accents
black-exterior.hint: Gloss or satin black grille, badges, spoiler and wheels for a darker, meaner look.

rear-spoiler.name: Rear spoiler
rear-spoiler.hint: A lip on the trunk lid. Mostly a style element at road speeds.

hood-scoop.name: Functional hood scoop
hood-scoop.hint: An air intake in the hood. On the GT it is real and feeds cooler air to the engine, and it gives the V6 car a V8 look.

front-splitter.name: Front splitter
front-splitter.hint: A blade under the front bumper that cuts air at speed and makes the car look lower and sportier.

performance-suspension.name: Performance suspension
performance-suspension.hint: Firmer springs and shocks so the car leans less in corners. Slightly harsher over bumps.

performance-brakes.name: Performance brakes
performance-brakes.hint: Larger brake discs and calipers that stop better and resist fading when used hard.

brembo-brakes.name: Brembo 4-piston brakes
brembo-brakes.hint: High-end brake calipers (usually painted red). Strong, consistent braking for spirited driving.

bilstein-shocks.name: Bilstein performance shocks
bilstein-shocks.hint: Premium shock absorbers that control the body better in corners without being too harsh.

axle-307.name: 3.07 rear axle ratio
axle-307.hint: A shorter final drive gear than the base car. The car feels quicker off the line at the cost of slightly higher revs on the highway.

limited-slip.name: Limited-slip differential
limited-slip.hint: Splits power between the rear wheels so the one with grip keeps pushing. Helps when accelerating out of corners and on slippery roads.

performance-steering.name: Performance steering
performance-steering.hint: Quicker, weightier steering that feels more connected to the road.

performance-steering-wheel.name: Performance steering wheel with paddle shifters
performance-steering-wheel.hint: A thicker, sportier wheel (flat-bottom on some packages) with paddles to change gears manually.

block-heater.name: Engine block heater
block-heater.hint: Plugs into a wall outlet to keep the engine warm overnight in very cold climates so it starts easily.

compact-spare.name: Compact spare tire
compact-spare.hint: A small temporary spare wheel. Without it the car only has a tire inflator kit, which cannot fix a torn tire.

rear-spoiler-black.name: Satin black rear spoiler
rear-spoiler-black.hint: The same trunk spoiler the car already has, but painted satin black instead of body colour. A style change, not an extra part.

wheels-20-black.name: 20-inch black-painted wheels
wheels-20-black.hint: Large wheels in gloss or satin black. On the SXT they also upsize the wheels from 18 inches. On the GT they replace the standard 20-inch wheels with black ones (19-inch on AWD cars).

wheels-20x9.name: 20 x 9-inch wider wheels
wheels-20x9.hint: Wider 20-inch wheels (9 inches across instead of 8) with wider tires for more grip in corners. Usually in a dark 'Lights Out' finish. Replaces the GT's standard 20-inch wheels.

flat-bottom-steering-wheel.name: Flat-bottom performance steering wheel
flat-bottom-steering-wheel.hint: A sport steering wheel with a flattened bottom edge for more leg room and a race-car feel. Replaces the standard round performance wheel.

ambient-lighting.name: Ambient interior lighting
ambient-lighting.hint: Soft LED lighting around the cabin at night.

surround-camera.name: 360-degree surround-view camera
surround-camera.hint: Stitches several cameras into a bird's-eye view of the car for parking. Note: never offered on the Challenger, which only has a rear camera. Listed here because it appears on many other cars.
